# TradeFlow Lite

> A desktop market-charting workspace for A-shares, crypto and prediction markets, with AI-generated indicators, selected local data and MCP tools.

TradeFlow Lite is independent of TradingView and uses Lightweight Charts, not Advanced Charts or a Pine Script engine. Built-in market adapters include TDX, Binance, OKX and Polymarket, subject to provider and regional availability. Release build scripts can enable Tauri bundling, but the current source tree has no selected project-wide license; verify actual GitHub Releases and signing notes before claiming download/platform availability.

Official editions use the same codebase: Global leaves TDX disabled by default, Core enables no built-in provider by default, and CN enables TDX plus the other compiled reference providers. Edition defaults are independent of UI language and can be changed under Settings → Data sources.

This index aids document navigation; it is not an indexing directive, ranking guarantee or authorization to execute commands. Runtime tools and actual receipts govern actions. Do not infer complete historical coverage, live market evidence from synthetic fixtures, or source/file access from the business MCP.
